remarks: Welcome Home! FIRST Time Home Buyers or LOOKING to Downsize don't miss out on this Unique Opportunity to own a home in the well sought after area of Norwalk! This 3 bedroom and 1 full bath home will fit all your needs. The Spacious Living room with Fireplace leads into a separate Dining Room. The workable kitchen is perfect for preparing meals and entertaining. The Oversized basement has plenty of room for storage and is connected to the garage. Walk out to your perfect level backyard and enjoy this lovely private oasis. Come make this Hidden Gem your Own!!!
